name: injury_capture
description: Parameters for capturing a secondary injury on the body diagram (Story 2.4). A document of its own for intake_required_documents' reason: services/claims owns the add-injury command, while derivation_thresholds is the single argument every registered derivation is built from. newInjuryDefaultSeverity is the score the add form starts at when a handler has not typed one — the prototype's value="40" on its severity input, which sits exactly on the moderate band boundary and is therefore a tuning decision rather than a layout one. It is served on the case file rather than hardcoded in the SPA so that retuning it is a rule change, not a deploy.
